description: Presets are the way to chain ops (resize → convert → sharpen…) and to keep output consistent across batches. Pass the preset slug or id (built-ins like builtin-util-to-webp, or your own), or slug@version — what save_preset answers with — to run exactly that version. A preset whose first step is generate starts from its prompt and takes no images: call it with the preset alone, or with a prompt of your own for this run and a count. For a recurring character or product, a preset's `subjects` carry both halves of consistency — the reference images pin the geometry and each subject's locked `descriptor` expands into the prompt wherever the preset's prompt or yours writes {{subject.<name>}} — so a new scene is a new prompt here, not a new version, and it names the subject as {{subject.<name>}} instead of re-describing it. Cost: AI ops charge credits per item (see the estimate); deterministic ops (resize/convert/compress/crop/pad/grayscale/rotate/flip/flop/trim/flatten/adjust/mask/blur_region/overlay/caption/render_template) are free on paid plans and count against the Free plan's monthly quota. Set dry_run=true to get the exact price without spending. Errors come back structured: `retryable` says whether the same call can be retried; `param` names the input to fix.

collection.description: Collection to put the new assets in (an opaque name; search_assets filters on it). Without one, an output made from an asset is in that asset's collection.

count.description: How many images a preset that starts from a prompt makes; default 1. With images, one output per input.

dry_run.description: Price only — nothing is created, uploaded or charged. asset_ids are priced as themselves; file_paths and urls by how many there are, since the price depends on the op, model and parameters, never on the image.

file_paths.description: Local files to upload first (only when the server runs on your machine over stdio).

idempotency_key.description: Your key for this submission. Calling again with the same key and the same arguments returns the job the first call created instead of submitting (and charging for) a second one; the same key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reuse. Use one when you might retry after a timeout.

preset.description: Preset slug or id, or slug@version to run exactly that version.

prompt.description: This run's prompt, in place of the one on the preset's AI step. {{subject.<name>}} expands to that subject's descriptor. A preset of several steps, or with no AI step, refuses it (invalid_param on prompt).

publish.description: Publish result assets so each output has a stable publicUrl on the CDN — the output itself at full size, not a thumbnail.

retention_days.description: Keep what this call stores — the images you hand it and the ones it makes — this many days instead of the account's plan retention. Shorter only: more is kept for the plan's time. Use it when the outputs are consumed at once (posted, sent on) and need not be kept.

urls.description: Public http(s) image URLs to ingest first.

wait.description: Wait for the job to finish (up to wait_seconds) and return its outputs. false → return the job handle now; poll with job_status.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait when wait=true.

name: run_preset
title: Run a saved preset (a versioned list of steps) on assets
